messages:
tayla-support: Hey team, customer on the free tier ran a demo and hit repeated 429s. They repro with a steady stream of short generation calls (chat) and are seeing rate_limit_exceeded. They need a short-lived bump for a live demo in ~2 hours.

tayla-support: Repro snippet they used:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-demo-xxxx' -d '{"model":"gpt-small","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"summarize"}]}'
```
Response: 
```json
{"error":{"type":"rate_limit_exceeded","message":"Too many requests"},"status":429}
```
Headers they saw: `x-rw-rate-limit-limit: 60`, `x-rw-rate-limit-remaining: 0`, `retry-after: 15`

tayla-support: Can we do a one-off concurrency/throughput increase for the next 3 hours? It's a strategic demo (seed-stage startup) and sales wants to avoid losing them.

oliver-eng: Thanks — first pass: the headers look like a per-key concurrency window (60/min). Is this demo hitting concurrency or steady per-minute burst? Can you ask for a short trace or timeframe and approx RPS?

tayla-support: Customer reported ~20 calls in 30s bursts repeatedly for ~10 minutes. I asked for raw logs but they sent the curl above and the 429 payload.

lina-infra: We can do a temporary quota override via the admin console for free-tier keys (set limit to 600/min for 3h) — requires approvals from sales for billing touches. If you confirm customer email + company, I can queue the override. Note: this bypasses the usual plan enforcement for the window; ensure we document start/end times.

ryan-sales: Customer: beta@flareai.io, company: FlareAI (seed). They're demoing to a VC panel in 2 hours. Approve temporary uplift. We should also offer them a limited-time promo link to convert to paid afterwards.

oliver-eng: Also FYI — if they're seeing many short calls, suggest using streaming or batching user prompts into fewer requests. That reduces token cost and avoids spikes. If they can't change client, the temporary override is fine.

tayla-support: Lina, please proceed with the 3h override starting at 1759999200 (in ~5m). I'll tell customer to retry after you confirm.

quota-bot: [system] Temporary override ticket created: OVERRIDE-2026-487. Target key: sk-demo-xxxx. Limit set: 600/min for 3 hours. Expires: 175...9200 + 10800s.

lina-infra: Done — OVERRIDE-2026-487 applied. Monitor metrics and if errors persist send logs.

tayla-support: Sending confirmation to customer now.

ryan-sales: I'll follow up with an upgrade CTA and a 30% trial discount for the first month.

oliver-eng: If you still see 429s after override, collect: sample request ids, response headers, and timestamps. Paste small excerpt here and I can check routing/quotas.

tayla-support: Will do. Thanks all :thumbsup:
